newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks end down after five-day rally.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks end down after five-day rally.

text.p: The Tokyo stock market"s key index saw its five-day rally end on Tuesday as global blue-chips lost their shine with investors after recent heavy gains, brokers said.
The Nikkei 225 average fell 279.90 points or 1.49 percent to the day"s low of 18,470.75.
Its March futures shed 220 points to end at 18,500.

After the market closed, the head of a bankers" industry group said bank debentures issued by long-term credit banks were not covered by Japan"s deposit insurance law.
Last week, media reports saying Japan"s ruling Liberal Democratic Party expected creditors holding bank debentures to be protected through the use of public funds bolstered bank shares.
On the foreign section of the Tokyo bourse, shares in Hong Kong real estate developer Henderson Land Developement Co Ltd 8990.T fell 20 yen to 1,080 yen.
The second section index closed 9.40 points higher at 1,738.09, with 11.03 million shares traded.
The over-the-counter (OTC) index was down 4.46 points at 1,224.45.
